subject: spell_data_shape
claim: On r806919, all 18,173 TemplateManifest entries under Spells/ expose the 56 declared SpellTemplate properties listed here, and grouping them by m_sMagicSchoolName yields the counts below, including three empty values.
how_to_repeat: Read Bin/revision.dat from your own install and confirm it reports r806919.Wizard_1_610.
Run the built client tool with `client template --list Spells/` and confirm that it lists 18,173 entries.
Decode every listed template id with `client template <id>` in batches, and group the resulting records by m_sMagicSchoolName, counting an empty value separately.
Run `client types 1864220976` against the type dump built from that install and compare the 56 SpellTemplate declarations with spell_template_properties.
evidence: The built client tool listed 18,173 installed templates under Spells/; every entry was decoded in batches and returned m_sMagicSchoolName.

Counts grouped by m_sMagicSchoolName were: Balance 1,736; Cantrips 162; CastleMagic 332; Death 1,785; Fire 1,796; Fishing 49; Gardening 146; Ice 1,769; Life 1,702; Moon 370; Myth 4,801; Shadow 874; Star 558; Storm 1,607; Sun 389; WhirlyBurly 94; empty 3. The counts sum to 18,173.

Decoded template class counts were: SpellTemplate 14,856; TieredSpellTemplate 2,579; CastleMagicSpellTemplate 290; CantripsSpellTemplate 162; FishingSpellTemplate 49; GardenSpellTemplate 143; WhirlyBurlySpellTemplate 94. These counts sum to 18,173.
The type dump identifies class SpellTemplate with hash 1864220976 and 56 declared properties.
disproof: A repeat against r806919 that finds a different Spells/ manifest count, a SpellTemplate declaration missing or added in the type dump, a decoded entry without m_sMagicSchoolName, or different grouped counts would disprove this catalog.
